name: Dilara Özkaya Çelebi
bio: Dilara Özkaya Çelebi was born on April 28, 1995. She graduated from the Painting Department of the Faculty of Fine Arts at Samsun Ondokuz Mayıs University. She expresses her talent in illustration and her passion for art through professional drawings, especially for children’s books. She first met readers with her debut book Maya, The Story of a Happy Child, which she both wrote and illustrated. Dilara sees this journey filled with art and creativity as a reflection of the originality and passion in her work. Through children’s books, she aims to nurture children’s imagination and open the door to new worlds for them.
